summary: Reports detected display monitors, resolution, desktop positioning, monitor names, GPU details, primary display status, and optional overall bounds.

key_params.name: callbacks
key_params.note: Callback DAT for monitor plug, unplug, resolution, or primary-display changes

key_params.name: bounds
key_params.note: Include an overall desktop bounds row

key_params.name: monitors
key_params.note: Select which monitor rows to output

key_params.name: units
key_params.note: Choose DPI-scaled or native pixel-style coordinate units

key_params.name: customext
key_params.note: Custom editor extension when Extension is set to Custom Extension

key_params.name: extension
key_params.note: Edit/view file extension exposed to external editors

key_params.name: wordwrap
key_params.note: Common DAT node-display word wrap setting

common_gotchas: Top and bottom coordinates are expressed in TouchDesigner's lower-left-origin coordinate convention.
DPI-scaled and native units can differ on high-DPI systems.
Monitor rows can change at runtime when displays are connected, disconnected, or reconfigured.
The bounds row has different semantics than an individual monitor row and should be handled separately.
key_concepts: Lists detected display monitors and monitor bounds.
Bounds and Monitors controls choose which monitor information appears.
Units changes whether monitor coordinates are reported in pixels or another unit mode.
Callbacks can react when monitor layout information changes.
